"The UAE has quietly reached out to Pakistan, seeking re-engagement. The move comes after an apparent realization among Emirati decision-makers that Pakistan is too important a country to be on the wrong side of. There is also a shift in the UAE’s policy. Unlike its earlier stance, Abu Dhabi now favors diplomacy to resolve the Iran-US conflict," - Kamran Yousaf of TRT World and Express News Pakistan.

The UAE paid reputation management firm Terakeet $6 million+ to suppress a 2017 Intercept article about Ambassador Yousef al-Otaiba's alleged ties to sex workers. Tactics included fake Wikipedia edits, planted profiles at Harvard and Milken Institute, and SEO manipulation — all handled in-person to avoid a digital trail. It worked: the article dropped from page one to page five. The same firm is linked to the Epstein Files through its work for Goldman Sachs executive Kathryn Ruemmler, who ultimately resigned anyway. Source: MEE, NYT

US Popularity in Japan Falls Below 30% Japan Times reported: According to the latest monthly survey by Jiji Press, the popularity of the United States among the Japanese public has significantly decreased, falling below 30% for the first time since the beginning of Trump's second term. Analysts attribute this sharp decline to the strong dissatisfaction of the Japanese people with Washington's aggressive policies, particularly the military attacks on Iran and the resulting energy crisis, which have directly impacted Tokyo's economy.

Turkish Foreign Ministry: We condemn the intervention carried out by Israeli forces in international waters against the Global Sumud Flotilla, which was formed to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza, as yet another act of piracy. The flotilla includes citizens from approximately 40 countries. Israel’s attacks and intimidation policies will in no way deter the international community’s pursuit of justice and solidarity with the Palestinian people. Israel must immediately cease its intervention and unconditionally release the detained flotilla participants. Necessary initiatives are being undertaken to ensure the safe return of our citizens aboard the flotilla to our country, and the process is being closely monitored in cooperation with other countries. We call on the international community to adopt a united and resolute stance without delay against Israel’s unlawful actions.

▪️ Chevron, Qatar-based UCC Holding, and the Syrian Petroleum Company have identified an offshore block for Syria’s first deep-water oil and gas exploration project. ▪️ The project is part of efforts to attract foreign investment into Syria’s energy sector following years of war and sanctions. ▪️ The Syrian Petroleum Company said the step follows a preliminary agreement signed in February to evaluate offshore exploration in Syrian waters. ▪️ The move marks an initial phase toward technical preparation and potential development of offshore resources in the eastern Mediterranean. Hezbollah's military structure is precisely and regionally divided, with each unit operating in a specific area with defined operational duties. In this post, we intend to learn more about the units of the heroic Hezbollah. ⚫ Haidar Unit Deployment location: Northern Lebanon and areas north of the Litani River Mission: Strategic deployment in northern areas and creation of initial defensive layers 🔴 Beirut Unit Deployment location: Beirut city and surrounding areas Mission: Managing organizational presence and structural activities in the capital ⚪ Badr Unit Deployment location: Beqaa Valley and central sections Mission: Serving as the center of gravity for command, fire control, defense, and weapons storage 🟢 Nasser Unit Deployment location: Southern Lebanon, especially the Nabatieh axis Mission: Operational support, field deployment, and strengthening southern lines 🟡 Aziz Unit Deployment location: Southwestern Lebanon, especially the Tyre region Mission: Weapons maintenance and management of short-range rocket launch infrastructure ⚔️ Radwan Unit (Special Force) Deployment location: North of Litani, Beqaa, and active presence in Southern Lebanon Mission: Carrying out offensive operations, infiltration, and special ground and naval operations

Deputy Minister of Roads and Urban Development during a visit to Shajareh Tayebeh Primary School in Minab: Housing loan deposits for repairing and rebuilding homes damaged or destroyed in the war will be paid from 400 million to 2 billion Tomans. This loan, commensurate with the rates in counties, provincial capitals, and metropolitan areas, will be paid to property owners with established cases from the mortgage funds provided to housing banks. The construction of destroyed homes in metropolitan areas is the responsibility of municipalities, and in other counties of the country, it is spearheaded by the Housing Foundation.
